highlight: Empréndete brand and Webflow blog, from scratch.
paragraphs: At CONTPAQi I built Empréndete from scratch, a university blog on Webflow made with user-centered design and Design Thinking: site architecture, mobile-first navigation, UX writing and CMS management. The blog increased engagement among accounting students and brought new sales and strategic partnerships.
Alongside it I gave talks at universities on user experience, innovation and user-centered methods, raising the company's visibility in academia.
